comment: With !menu_overlay, wintty.c tty_display_nhwindow() moves every menu to column 0 and clears the screen with term_clear_screen() before drawing it. Applying the empty sack runs pickup.c use_container(): its "Do what with it?" menu, the class menu, and "Put in what?"; a second apply takes the touchstone back out through "Take out what?".
